details:
1. Result verbosity: 1-sentence summary; details ≤5 lines (files + blockers).
2. File reading: only files_to_read; request extras via issues.
3. Model discipline: honor model/complexity (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH).
4. Output discipline: no extra docs/comments/follow-ups unless spec requires.
5. Context loading: no rule repetition or core-context playback.
6. Session scope: single claimed task; block if unclear; no chaining without depends_on.
